description: This Java class 'ScriptUtil' provides utility methods for integrating scripting engines (JSR-223) within the OFBiz framework. It manages script compilation, execution, context creation, and supports multiple scripting languages like Groovy. It also handles caching of compiled scripts and provides mechanisms for secure variable bindings.

classes.name: ProtectedBindings
classes.description: A custom implementation of Bindings that enforces read-only restrictions on protected keys.

methods.name: compileScriptFile
methods.description: Compiles a script file into a Cached Script object, supporting caching and engine selection based on file extension.

methods.name: compileScriptString
methods.description: Compiles a script string into a Cached Script object based on language, with caching.

methods.name: createScriptContext
methods.description: Creates a ScriptContext with provided context map, including helper objects and bindings.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a script string in a specified language and context, optionally using a script class.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a compiled script or script file at a given location, with optional function invocation and context.

methods.name: parseScript
methods.description: Parses a script into a class object for Groovy scripts.
